ai.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
ai.brief: Nvidia’s board of directors announced Sunday that it’s launching an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation . Nvidia also published a message that Huang sent to the company admitting that he had an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed (though he didn’t mention her by name). S. policymakers earlier this year claimed that Alice Huang had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia’s CEO. “I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Jensen Huang wrote. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. ” Huang added that he’d “fallen short” of his responsibility to the company.

sec.title: Don’t Hand Propaganda a Gift: Reading the Brenner Base Tunnel SE Breach Calmly
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. CISA adds WordPress flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Brenner Base Tunnel (BBT) SE, the company building the Brenner Base Tunnel between Italy and Austria, has confirmed that unauthorized people accessed some of its data. The extortion group Everest claims it took 812 GB of files. Nobody has verified that, and a criminal bragging about file sizes isn’t an audited source. The timeline is thin. The intrusion reportedly dates to mid-October, Everest’s claim to 17 October, and the Austrian press broke the story on 6 November. On 7 November BBT SE told ANSA that operations are unaffected, the systems involved are isolated, and outside forensic experts and the authorities are on the case. If real and current, drawings, surveys and site procedures would save an attacker a lot of reconnaissance.
